recipe.visualDefinition: A vertically oriented graphic composition featuring a high-contrast, halftone-textured portrait of a musician centered against a vibrant horizontal color gradient, framed by solid black and teal blocks containing bold, condensed typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Strict horizontal banding dividing the canvas into four distinct zones.
High-contrast black ink illustration against a soft, saturated color gradient.
Bold, uniform typographic weight across all text elements.
Central figure anchored by the horizon line of the bottom text blocks.
coreInvariants: Halftone dot pattern in the shadows of the central figure.
A smooth vertical gradient transitioning from magenta to yellow to cyan.
Solid black header and footer blocks for text contrast.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure occupies the middle 50% of the vertical space, scaled to waist-up view.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark silhouette of the musician's jacket and guitar provides a heavy central anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical scan: Header text to central portrait to footer text blocks.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The gradient background acts as active negative space, providing air around the central figure.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black (used for text blocks and figure shadows).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Teal (used for the bottom-most block and secondary text).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-saturation gradient background contrasted against flat, low-value black blocks.

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard condensed geometric forms.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monospaced or wide-tracked variations of the same condensed face for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, vertical presence of the header.
Provides the clean, modern-retro condensed look for the footer.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vertical layout with four horizontal bands. Top band is solid black. Middle band is a vertical gradient from magenta to yellow to cyan. Third band is solid black. Bottom band is solid teal. Place a high-contrast black and white halftone illustration of a man with a guitar in the center of the gradient band.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add extra-condensed bold sans-serif text in uppercase. Top text in pink, middle text in teal, bottom text in black. Center all text horizontally within their respective color blocks.

verificationChecks: Is the gradient smooth and vertical?
Is the central figure rendered with a visible halftone dot pattern?
Are there four distinct horizontal color zones?
Is the typography strictly uppercase and condensed?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the musician
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white border frames the entire composition.
Verify the halftone texture is present in the subject's shadows.
Check that the text colors match the specified block-contrast rules.
Confirm the vertical alignment of all elements.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast halftone subject + 4-tier horizontal color blocking + condensed sans-serif display type.
